name: National Bank World Elite Mastercard

apr.notes: 20.99% purchase rate; 22.49% on balance transfers and cash advances.

credit_required.notes: Minimum annual income of $80,000 for the applicant or $150,000 household income. Subject to National Bank credit approval.

base_rate.description: 1 point per dollar on other purchases.

categories.label: Groceries and restaurants (5 points on the first $2,500 in gross monthly purchases charged to the account, then 2 points)
Gas and electric vehicle charging, recurring bill payments, and A la carte Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem your points for rewards such as items, gift cards and travel discounts, or use them to pay off your card balance; $100 off per 10,000 points on A la carte Travel.

signup_bonus.description: 10,000 points for payment insurance enrollment for the first 90 days, 5,000 points after $5,000 in net purchases in the first 90 days, 10,000 points after $20,000 in net purchases in the first 12 months, and 10,000 points for opening a first eligible current account.

benefits.title: Travel expense refund
benefits.description: Up to a $150 refund per year on travel expenses.

benefits.title: National Bank Lounge access
benefits.description: Free and unlimited access with a guest and two children aged 12 or under to the National Bank Lounge at Montreal-Trudeau Airport.

notes: Annual fee for the second authorized card is $50. Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name.
